## The Legal Staffing Challenge

Legal work is inherently cyclical. M&A deals, litigation cases, and regulatory projects create intense workload spikes that your core team can't always absorb without burnout.

Hiring full-time for short-term needs is inefficient, but you can't compromise on quality, confidentiality, or expertise. One weak link can jeopardize an entire case.

Traditional legal temp agencies charge premium rates and often deliver generalists. You need specialists who understand your practice area from day one.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Experienced paralegals with practice-area specialization (litigation, corporate, IP, etc.)
- Contract attorneys for document review, due diligence, and research overflow
- All candidates screened for credentials, bar status (where applicable), and references
- Strict NDAs and confidentiality training standard for every placement
- Quick onboarding. Most candidates productive within 48-72 hours
